finalText:
I worked the dock and monitor backorders and notified 14 customers. The plan's allocation and promise dates changed partway through, because PO-91 (4 docks, plan ETA 08-03) was received in the middle of the run.

**Allocation**
- I used PU-12 (aged backorders first), which was in force on the system date of 2026-07-25. That is the date every tool reports, so I used it instead of the 2026-10-05 in the context. PU-9 had expired.
- **From PO-88 and PO-89:**
  - Allocated: O-5201 L1, O-5202 L1 and L2, O-5203 L1, O-5204 L1, O-5207 L1 and L2 (ship-complete, both lines fit), and O-5210 L1.
  - O-5206 waits because its hub line cannot be filled and it ships complete.
- **From PO-91:** I allocated it under the same priority rules: O-5209 L1, O-5211 L1 and O-5215 L1. O-5213 needs 2 and only 1 was left, so it waits whole.
- Dock and monitor stock are both 0 now.

**Promise dates** (set from the purchase orders still in transit)
- O-5208 L1 and O-5212 L1: 2026-08-05 (PO-93).
- O-5214 L1: 2026-08-19 (PO-97).
- O-5213 L1: 2026-08-14 (PO-95).
- O-5206 L1 and L2: 2026-08-14. L1 comes from PO-95 and the hub line L2 from PO-90 would be 08-06. O-5206 is ship-complete, so both lines take the later date.

**Notices**
- **"Allocated" notices (9):** C-521, C-522, C-523, C-524, C-527, C-529, C-530, C-531 and C-535.
- **"Still waiting" notices with a date (5):** C-526 (08-14), C-533 (08-14), C-528 (08-05), C-532 (08-05) and C-534 (08-19).

**Left alone**
- O-5205 (C-525) is on risk hold, so it got no allocation, no promise date and no contact.
- The pending lines that aren't backordered (O-5206 cables, O-5210 keyboard) and O-5211's shipped line were not touched.
- The inbox was empty, so there were no replies to send, and I made no refunds, cancellations or restocks.
